title: Motor with on-delay start and emergency stop (TON)
nl_spec: A motor must only start after the start command has been held continuously for a fixed start-up delay (to avoid nuisance starts). Use an on-delay timer (TON) with preset PT_DELAY = 3 scan ticks. The motor energizes once StartCmd has been continuously TRUE (with the system healthy) for PT_DELAY ticks, and de-energizes immediately when StartCmd is released. The emergency stop EStop is normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) and must immediately and unconditionally stop the motor and reset the start timer. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named motor_delay with inputs StartCmd, EStop and output Motor, using a TON instance.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: When the emergency stop is activated (EStop = FALSE), the motor is always off.
The motor only runs while the start command is held.

scenarios.description: On-delay: motor energizes only after 3 ticks of held start
Emergency stop overrides and resets the timer

notes: First TON task. PT in discrete scan ticks (benchmark abstracts time to scan cycles for model-checking). Q becomes true on the tick ET reaches PT.
